dark_swim_path_068.reference: Fresh actual Chao Island viewer yellow Swim checkbox, full Dark alignment, fresh front/side/back/above and mature balanced side/back/above plus all nine mature side views personally opened before authoring. Additional angles and age research retained separately.
dark_swim_path_068.approximation: Original square skull retained exactly. Narrow upper root/hook plus broad lower transverse hood and narrow terminal, with two small positive lateral spurs. Run raises both rear extensions; Power thickens the upper hook and drops the hood; Swim lengthens the descending rear hood; Fly extends flatter rear hooks and lateral spurs. The source Swim hood reaches near the feet; this closed-box hood is shorter and shallower to clear the retained full gaze, upright skull and forward crawling head. Smooth taper, curved fins, pointed ends and source skull wedge are simplified into six closed cuboids and flat color regions. Linear age/bilinear training approximates nonlinear source timing.
dark_swim_path_068.wing_policy: Three opaque closed cuboid rays per exact original wing joint; all rays share proximal hinge[0,.25,0]. Actual Minecraft/viewer preflight showed mature Fly wings hidden behind the arms; Fly/RunFly/PowerFly mature spans are enlarged while other endpoints stay exact. Fresh swatches107/106 follow four longitudinal face interiors. Original parent yaw/pivots and older family animations unchanged.
dark_swim_path_068.body_contact_policy: Torso top extends .45modelpixels for existing scoped walking lift; wrists keep original upperplane, soles/heels fixed. No intended headfeature contact with torso, hands, wings, feet or tail.
dark_swim_path_068.marker_policy: Original dot core and all expression joints/visibility exact; six same-bone closed protrusions interpret observed Dark spikedball, never a Hero halo.
dark_swim_path_068.tail_policy: Two slim connected closed rearward/upturned boxes on existing tail__cube_0 and joint; original tail__cube_1 base unchanged. Scoped prone stem folding pivots about an interior point of that unchanged base, avoiding the head hood while preserving the attachment.
